brief: Plateful plans a week of meals in 2 minutes and builds one shopping list sorted by aisle. In a 2026 beta, testers went from 4 takeout nights a week to 1. Offer: 14-day free trial.

hook.line: Your meal plan isn't the problem.
hook.visual: a full fridge door swung open, every shelf packed with untouched groceries, a takeout bag on the counter in front of it

shot.state: fridge door OPEN, takeout bag on the counter

hook_candidates.text: Your meal plan isn't the problem.
The fridge is full. You still order takeout.
Meal prep doesn't fail on Sunday.
Groceries aren't why dinner goes wrong.

beats.line: By Wednesday the fridge is full and you're ordering takeout again.
beats.visual: Maya on the sofa at night scrolling a delivery app, the lit kitchen doorway behind her

people.MAYA: on the sofa, tired, phone in one hand at chest height

beats.line: Plateful plans your whole week in two minutes, then builds one shopping list sorted by aisle.
beats.visual: close on a phone held upright showing a week of meals in a grid, the aisle soft behind it

shot.state: phone screen shows a 7-day meal grid

beats.line: In our beta, testers went from four takeout nights a week to one.
beats.visual: a paper wall calendar filling the whole frame, one week row with four takeout stickers in a line: the first three each crossed out with a thick black X, the fourth left uncrossed, morning light

shot.camera: extreme close-up, straight on, the calendar fills the frame, no room visible
shot.state: exactly three of four stickers crossed out

beats.line: Plan your first week free for fourteen days.
beats.visual: the phone on a clean counter beside a cooked dinner plate, app open on the week view, space for an offer card at the top

cast.MAYA: woman in her thirties, shoulder-length dark brown hair, warm brown skin, tired kind eyes, medium build

MAYA.default: oversized grey knit sweater, dark leggings

sets.KITCHEN: INTERIOR ONLY: a small modern apartment kitchen, white cabinets, one window, flat white ceiling, light from the window
sets.LIVING: INTERIOR ONLY: a small apartment living room at night, grey sofa, floor lamp the only light, flat white ceiling, kitchen doorway lit behind
sets.AISLE: INTERIOR ONLY: one supermarket aisle, shelves of dry goods both sides, flat white ceiling, even overhead strip lights
